node.statement: The explicit 3x3 family P_s=I-u_s v_s^T (v_s=(1,-1+s,-s), u_s=(1-s+s^2,-s,0)^T) is a signed affine retraction with neg mass delta=s^2 whose distance to every stochastic idempotent is 2s-2s^2+2s^3 = 2 sqrt(delta)+O(delta): no bound C delta^beta with beta>1/2 holds, so the exponent 1/2 in op-classical/op-npps is sharp.
